units.text: INT. SUPERMAN - CONTINUOUS
interested.
What did it do?
units.name: STRAKER

units.text: It carried three brave comrades of ours, who did not know how to stop it, into Granada, and capsized them opposite the police station. Since then we never touch one without sending for the chauffeur. Shall we chat at our ease?
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: By all means.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Tanner, Mendoza, and Straker sit down on the turf by the fire.

Mendoza delicately waives his presidential dignity, of which the right to sit on the squared stone block is the appanage, by sitting on the ground like his guests, and using the stone only as a support for his back.

It is the custom in Spain always to put off business until to-morrow. In fact, you have arrived out of office hours. However, if you would prefer to settle the question of ransom at once, I am at your service.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: To-morrow will do for me. I am rich enough to pay anything in reason.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: respectfully, much struck by this admission.
You are a remarkable man, sir. Our guests usually describe themselves as miserably poor.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: Pooh! Miserably poor people don't own motor cars.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Precisely what we say to them.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: Treat us well: we shall not prove ungrateful.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: No prickly pears and broiled rabbits, you know. Don't tell me you can't do us a bit better than that if you like.
units.name: STRAKER

units.text: Wine, kids, milk, cheese and bread can be procured for ready money.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: graciously.
Now you're talking.
units.name: STRAKER

units.text: Are you all Socialists here, may I ask?
units.name: TANNER

units.text: repudiating this humiliating misconception.

Oh no, no, no: nothing of the kind, I assure you. We naturally have modern views as to the justice of the existing distribution of wealth: otherwise we should lose our self-respect. But nothing that you could take exception to, except two or three faddists.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: I had no intention of suggesting anything discreditable. In fact, I am a bit of a Socialist myself.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: drily.
Most rich men are, I notice.
units.name: STRAKER

units.text: Quite so. It has reached us, I admit. It is in the air of the century.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: Socialism must be looking up a bit if your chaps are taking to it.
units.name: STRAKER

units.text: That is true, sir. A movement which is confined to philosophers and honest men can never exercise any real political influence: there are too few of them. Until a movement shows itself capable of spreading among brigands, it can never hope for a political majority.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: But are your brigands any less honest than ordinary citizens?
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Sir: I will be frank with you. Brigandage is abnormal. Abnormal professions attract two classes: those who are not good enough for ordinary bourgeois life and those who are too good for it. We are dregs and scum, sir: the dregs very filthy, the scum very superior.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: Take care! some o the dregs'll hear you.
units.name: STRAKER

units.text: It does not matter: each brigand thinks himself scum, and likes to hear the others called dregs.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: Come! you are a wit.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Mendoza inclines his head, flattered.
May one ask you a blunt question?
units.name: TANNER

units.text: As blunt as you please.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: How does it pay a man of your talent to shepherd such a flock as this on broiled rabbit and prickly pears? I have seen men less gifted, and I'll swear less honest, supping at the Savoy on foie gras and champagne.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Pooh! they have all had their turn at the broiled rabbit, just as I shall have my turn at the Savoy. Indeed, I have had a turn there already--as waiter.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: A waiter! You astonish me!
units.name: TANNER

units.text: reflectively.
Yes: I, Mendoza of the Sierra, was a waiter. Hence, perhaps, my cosmopolitanism.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: With sudden intensity.
Shall I tell you the story of my life?
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: apprehensively.
If it ain't too long, old chap--
units.name: STRAKER

units.text: interrupting him.
Tsh-sh: you are a Philistine, Henry: you have no romance in you.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: To Mendoza.
